name: deepseek
description: Probe DeepSeek AI API endpoints: test the official API, reverse-engineer endpoints, and verify responses. Tests if the API responds to queries like 'How are you?' and returns the actual response.

arguments.name: api_key
arguments.description: DeepSeek API key (optional, tests without one first)

arguments.name: prompt
arguments.description: Test prompt (default: 'Reply in one word: how are you?')

output.description: Endpoint test results with status, response time, and actual response
